headline: S&P 500 Stock Centene Dives On Medicaid Outlook
summary: S&P 500 health insurer Centene blew away Q2 earnings forecasts amid lower-than-expected Affordable Care Act Marketplace benefit costs.  CNC stock initially moved higher, but shares reversed sharply lower as the company discussed its outlook, including slightly higher Medicaid attrition and a more costly covered population in the second half of 2026.  Centene posted Q2 earnings of $2.51 a share, crushing forecasts of $1.09 by $1.42 a share.

headline: Centene’s (NYSE:CNC) Q2 CY2026: Strong Sales, Guides for Strong Full-Year Sales
summary: Health coverage company Centene (NYSE:CNC) reported Q2 CY2026 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 9.9% year on year to $53.58 billion. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $195.5 billion at the midpoint came in 2.7% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.51 per share was significantly above analysts’ consensus estimates.
